edge.title: Muon update applied via hyperball step (MuonH); non-zero proj init
edge.summary: MuonH keeps Muon's Nesterov momentum (0.95) and 12-iteration Newton–Schulz direction but replaces W ← W·(1−lr·wd) − lr·O with the hyperball step: O is rescaled to Frobenius norm lr·‖W‖_F (so Muon's aspect-ratio factor cancels), subtracted, and W is renormalized to its previous norm. Every hidden matrix therefore stays on a sphere of its init radius and weight decay is removed; the residual projections get non-zero init (default Kaiming-uniform ×1.25 attn.proj, ×3.0 mlp.proj, ×1.5 mlp.fc) so they have a radius at all. The hidden lr (0.018) decays linearly from step 0 while aux AdamW decays over the last 40%, reaching 3.28 in 3325 steps (vs 3600).

changes.label: Muon step → hyperball step (MuonH)
changes.detail: MuonH.step calls the unchanged muon_update and then scale_invariant_update_(p, update, lr) instead of p.mul_(1 − lr·wd); p.add_(update, alpha=−lr). The update's own scale (incl. max(1, rows/cols)^0.5) is discarded and weight_decay 0.01 is gone.

changes.label: Non-zero per-module init
changes.detail: Default nn.Linear init is kept and scaled: attn.proj.weight ×1.25, mlp.proj.weight ×3.0, mlp.fc.weight ×1.5 (q/k/v ×1). Only the LM head proj.weight and the 'proj' biases are zeroed; #1 zeroed every 'proj' parameter.

changes.label: Split cooldown: hidden 1.0, aux 0.4
changes.detail: set_hparams uses cooldown_frac 1.0 for 'h' groups (multiplier 1 − step/3325 from step 0) and 0.4 for the AdamW groups (was a shared 0.7); no warmup.

changes.label: Steps 3600→3325, lr 0.02→0.018
changes.detail: train_steps = 3325 and MuonH lr = 0.018 (constructor default 0.014 is overridden); mu stays 0.95; aux AdamW unchanged.

changes.label: Four per-shape MuonH instances
changes.detail: q/k/v, mlp.fc, attn.proj and mlp.proj go to four MuonH optimizers with identical lr/mu (stated purpose: separate torch.compile caches) — same math as a single instance; docstrings and a device-name print added.

hparams_changed.label: proj init
hparams_changed.to: LM head + proj biases zero; attn.proj ×1.25, mlp.proj ×3.0 default init

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest code is #1 (96 changed lines); everything outside the optimizer, init and schedule is #1's skeleton.
edge.noise: The per-shape optimizer split (compile caching), docstrings and the device-name print are behavior-neutral.

techniques.note: Nesterov momentum 0.95 → NS5 (12 iters, a,b,c = 2, −1.5, 0.5); only its direction is used
all 72 block matrices pinned to init ‖W‖_F; pre-retraction step = lr·‖W‖_F; no wd
default Kaiming-uniform × attn.proj 1.25, mlp.proj 3.0, mlp.fc 1.5; q/k/v ×1
hidden: linear to 0 from step 0 (frac 1.0); aux: flat, then linear over last 40%
AdamW embed 0.3 / head 1/320 / 1-D 0.01, betas (0.8, 0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0

hparams.schedule.kind: linear decay; hidden from step 0, aux after 60%
hparams.hyperball.radius: per-matrix ‖W‖_F at init (expected ≈16 q/k/v, 20 attn.proj, 48 mlp.fc & mlp.proj)
hparams.init.proj: LM head proj.weight = 0; block proj weights non-zero
hparams.init.bias: proj biases 0; q/k/v/fc biases default uniform ±1/√fan_in

mechanisms.name: Hyperball (Frobenius-sphere) step
mechanisms.explain: scale_invariant_update_ rescales Muon's orthogonalized update O to Frobenius norm lr·‖W‖_F, subtracts it, and rescales the result back to the pre-step norm, so each hidden matrix stays on a sphere whose radius is its norm at initialization. The lr becomes a relative step (≈ the rotation angle along O's tangential part), O's magnitude — including Muon's max(1, rows/cols)^0.5 factor — is irrelevant, and weight decay is unnecessary because the norm cannot grow.

mechanisms.name: Per-module init multipliers
mechanisms.explain: Starting from PyTorch's default nn.Linear init (uniform, std 1/√(3·fan_in)), attn.proj is scaled ×1.25, mlp.proj ×3.0 and mlp.fc ×1.5 (std ≈ 0.026/0.031/0.031) while q/k/v keep std ≈ 0.0208. Because the hyperball freezes each matrix's norm, these multipliers fix the radii for the whole run (expected ‖W‖_F ≈ 16 for q/k/v, 20 for attn.proj, 48 for mlp.fc and mlp.proj).

mechanisms.name: Split cooldown
mechanisms.explain: Param groups are tagged schedule_type 'h' or 'aux'. MuonH groups use cooldown_frac 1.0 (linear decay from step 0 to 0 at the end), while the AdamW embed/head/scalar groups stay flat for 60% of the run and decay over the last 40%.

caveats: Radii are expected norms implied by the init std, not code constants. The repo's copy results/20260430_muonh/train_gpt_simple_muonh.py is a maintainer port to the updated skeleton whose init differs from the logged run (Gaussian std √(0.33/fan_in), all biases zero, LM head not zeroed despite its comment); this analysis follows the logged script, and #37 is built on the port.
